FindPage.title: Find a Handle
FindPage.notFound: We could not find a Handle for those words. Check the spelling, or put a dot between each emoji name, like ice-cube.ice-cube.ice-cube.

HandleBuilder.spokenEmpty: Pick three emoji, and this is how you will say your Handle.
HandleBuilder.pickerFull: All three slots are full. Clear one to swap an emoji.
HandleBuilder.pickerNoMatches: No emoji matches “{query}”. Try another word.
HandleBuilder.checking: Checking whether this Handle is free…
HandleBuilder.stateUnknown: We could not check this Handle just now.

HandlePage.unedited: Nobody has added anything here yet.
HandlePage.stateUnknown: We could not check this Handle just now.
HandlePage.aliasSeveral: Those words name more than one Handle, so there is no single page to show you.
HandlePage.aliasListing: Those words name more than one Handle. Here are the ones somebody has.
HandlePage.shareManual: Copying did not work, so the link is selected below. Copy it from there.

Claim.pendingBody: We have sent you a link to confirm your email address. Follow it and this Handle is yours.
Claim.linkExpiredBody: Links last an hour, and holds last a day — so this happens often. Your Handle is still held for you: ask for a new link below and you can finish claiming it.
Claim.linkSupersededBody: A newer link was sent, so this one no longer works — only the newest one does. Your Handle is still held for you. Use the most recent email, or ask for another link below.
Claim.unverifiedHeading: Confirm your email to sign in
Claim.unverifiedBody: This account has not been confirmed yet, so there is nothing to sign in to. Your Handle is still held for you — follow the link in your email, or ask for a new one below.
Claim.linkUnknownHeading: We could not read that link
Claim.linkUnknownBody: Either the link was cut in half by an email client, or the hold it belonged to ran out and the Handle went back into the pool. If your account is still waiting to be confirmed, asking for a new link below will reach it; if the hold has gone, pick a Handle again.
Claim.holdExpiredBody: A Handle is held for 24 hours while you confirm your email, and this one was not confirmed in time. It has gone back into the pool, so it may be free — or somebody else may have claimed it.
Claim.resendEmailLabel: The email address you signed up with
Claim.resendSent: If that address has an account waiting to be confirmed, a new link is on its way. It is the only one that will work from now on.
Claim.resendTooSoon: We can only send one link a minute. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
Claim.resendTooSoonOne: We can only send one link a minute. Try again in a second.
Claim.resendTooMany: That is as many links as we can send in an hour. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
Claim.resendTooManyOne: That is as many links as we can send in an hour. Try again in a minute.
Claim.resendInvalid: Enter the email address you signed up with.
Claim.resendFailed: We could not send a link just now. Try again in a moment.
Claim.verifiedBody: Your email is confirmed and this Handle is now yours for good.
Claim.signInInvalid: That email address and password do not match an account.
Claim.signInFailed: We could not sign you in just now. Try again in a moment.
Claim.signInRateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts from this connection. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
Claim.claimBody: Enter your email address and choose a password. We will hold this Handle for you for 24 hours while you confirm the address.
Claim.claimTaken: Somebody else has this Handle now. Pick another one above.
Claim.claimNotClaimable: This Handle cannot be claimed. Pick another one above.
Claim.claimNotAHandle: That is not a Handle. Pick three emoji above.
Claim.claimInvalid: Enter your email address and a password.
Claim.claimFailed: We could not claim this Handle just now. Try again in a moment.
Claim.claimRateLimited: There have been too many attempts to claim a Handle just now. Wait a while, then try again.

PasswordReset.resetDone: Your password has been changed, and every device that was signed in has been signed out. Sign in with your new password.
PasswordReset.requestIntro: Enter the email address you use for 3moji. If it belongs to an account, we will email a link to set a new password.
PasswordReset.requestSent: If that address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. The link works once, for an hour.
PasswordReset.requestRateLimited: Too many reset requests from this connection. Wait a while, then try again.
PasswordReset.requestFailed: We could not send a reset link just now. Try again in a moment.
PasswordReset.linkInvalid: That reset link does not work any more. Links work once, for an hour. Ask for a new one below.
PasswordReset.setTooShort: That password is too short. Use at least {min} characters.
PasswordReset.setTooLong: That password is too long. Use at most {max} characters.
PasswordReset.setFailed: We could not set your password just now. Try again in a moment.
